svg.text: On Linux since Ubuntu Warty (2004), moved through Debian-based
distros and have been Arch-based for the last ~10 years. For
the last 3 a 4 years my daily driver is Mabox Linux.
First code I ever wrote was on a Commodore 64 (1981) — moving
fields around the screen, putting together simple animations.
No formal background since — I learned by reading forum
threads and wikis, copy-pasting snippets together, a lot of
trial-and-error, then more reading until it actually made
sense. Most of it came from studying and forking scripts
across a lineage of distros: PsychOS, MX Linux, Puppy Linux,
ArcoLinux, and for the last few years Mabox scripts (by
Daniel). ArcoLinux and Mabox especially are where
understanding a script's structure — what a function is
actually doing, rather than just pattern-matching snippets —
started to click. Claude Code builds on that now, on bigger or
